packs.description: Built-in NPDev approvals pack: anyone with the 'requester' role files an approval request, a person with the 'approver' role decides it from My tasks (approve or reject, with a comment), and the pack records who decided, when and why. The two roles are logical: the importing app binds them to its own role names with provides.roleBindings { "requester": ..., "approver": ... }, and composition refuses when either is unbound. A resumed flow applies the decision as the person who started it and without that person's roles, so the rules also admit the platform's trusted resume principal (role ADMIN); who filed a request is the starter of its flow execution (My tasks shows it).
packs.author: NPDev

packs.description: Built-in NPDev contacts pack: organizations (customers, suppliers, partners), the people who work there, and their postal addresses -- with list/detail/edit screens and the common queries. Reference it from any business app instead of re-modelling a CRM-lite by hand.
packs.author: NPDev

packs.description: NPDev helpdesk pack: agents, ticket categories, tickets and ticket comments. A person with the 'requester' role raises tickets and adds comments but cannot read the queue; 'helpdeskAgent' works tickets (takes, waits on the requester, resolves, reopens, closes) and comments; 'helpdeskManager' also maintains agents and categories. A ticket is NEW, then OPEN, PENDING (waiting for the requester) and RESOLVED, and finally CLOSED; a ticket cannot be taken, paused, resolved or reopened without an assigned agent (it may still be closed without action straight from NEW). How many tickets are in each state and how many each agent holds are derived by queries. The three roles are logical: the importing app binds them with provides.roleBindings { "requester": ..., "helpdeskAgent": ..., "helpdeskManager": ... } (composition refuses when one is unbound) and grants them read/create/update on the pack's concepts in its own roles[] (see the dom-helpdesk sample).
packs.author: NPDev
